svg.title: 04 / Preview a small repair. Apply once. Undo once.
svg.desc: Essential workbench concept 04. A proposed bulk text repair in the existing tools pane: an exact mapping under an accepted filter, a bounded before/after preview of four toy rows, a disabled Apply with the reason, and the stale, failure and history states. EW-04D design only. Static drawing, synthetic data, not a runtime screenshot.
svg.text: STATIC CONCEPT • synthetic data • not a runtime screenshot
04 / Preview a small repair. Apply once. Undo once.
One exact text mapping on one column under an accepted filter — planned, previewed, applied atomically and undone in one step.
no bulk repair, no new edit operation and no engine change is implemented or approved

g.text: Map exact text on one column
as drawn — a volatile filter is unresolved
Trim is an alternative, not a default: code
points and edge-only behaviour are unchosen.

text.tspan: Apply unavailable until atomic design
and semantics are accepted.
No expression UI, regex, dedupe, fuzzy or
multi-column repair.
Full toy context includes nonmatching rows to show preservation. Only two match
the illustrated predicate; this is not a filtered viewport or a measured run.
Rows are logical identities (ADR 0011), never DOM rows; the plan targets the
effective view plus the accepted filter, whose membership may be volatile.

g.text: row 1 · id 0001 · name Aster Field Survey · status Needs review · amount 12.50
The live session shows no repair yet: the grid is the current effective view, and Record keeps logical row 1 selected until an applied outcome exists.

text.tspan: A new applied edit, a filter change, a rename or cast, or an
adoption invalidates the plan. Apply then refuses and asks
for a fresh preview instead of repairing a different set.
Scrolling and selection alone do not invalidate the plan; volatile
filter membership is still unresolved.
If the bounded engine operation fails, the previous history,
overlay and grid view stay exactly as they were: no partial
repair, no half-published history entry.
Transport failure, restore failure and repeat Apply still need a joint
rollback design; no engine Cancel or interrupt is claimed.
A successful repair publishes one History action: Undo
restores the prior overlay in a single step and Redo
re-applies it. Nothing is folded per cell.
Exact replay and refolding of active operations, and one
worker-plus-History publication boundary, must be specified before
this is real.

Owner: maintainer. Exact trim code points and edge-only scope · case, equality and collation · mapping collisions · simultaneous versus cascading replacement · NULL and empty policy · no-op and dirty treatment ·
inserted, deleted or previously edited rows · determinism of accepted filters · resource bounds.

A bounded atomic representation (compact relational operation or an engine-owned delta) · one logical publication boundary across worker and History · logical row identity, not DOM rows · no unbounded JavaScript
cell loop · exact replay and refolding · no false engine Cancel.
Out of scope: regex, deduplication, fuzzy matching, multi-column repair, range paste and a general expression UI.

svg.text: 1 Choose a bounded atomic representation → 2 Decide trim, case, NULL and collision semantics → 3 Specify joint worker + History publication → 4 Then an EW-04I brief

Tasks / specification: docs/product/16-essential-workbench-first-wave-spec.md §6 (EW-04D) · ADRs 0003 (engine owns data), 0011/0012 (logical identity, immutable source + overlay), 0029/0030 (SQL/Pipeline IR), 0044 (shell).

Synthetic data only · mapping, scope, counts and buttons are schematic and unapproved · “Synthetic complete-check example” is a four-row illustration, not a measured result · no runtime, timing or accessibility evidence claimed.
